name: print-social-white-grid-card-people-news-carousel-slide-with-cutouts
title: People News Slide with Cut-Out Team Photos
whatItIs: A portrait carousel slide on a stacked grid-paper card with a blue 'Company news' back link, a large 'People' heading, two icon bullets about new hires and an anniversary, cut-out portraits of team members and small circle portraits with handwritten names and curved arrows, and a Workshops link.
whatItMeans: Cut-out people with handwritten labels make company news feel personal and lively.
techniques: Cut-out photos overlapping the card edge
Circle portraits and large bust portraits mixed
Series chrome with slide counter and tags

vocabulary.definition: A person masked from their background.
A script-style name with a hand-drawn arrow.
Repeated header and footer elements across slides.
